title: Design and Building Practitioners Act registration scheme (NSW)
summary: The Design and Building Practitioners Act 2020 imposed a statutory duty of care from 10 June 2020 and, from 1 July 2021, mandatory registration of design practitioners, building practitioners and professional engineers and compliance declarations for class 2 (apartment) buildings.

instruments.title: Design and Building Practitioners Act 2020 No 7

commenced.what: Duty of care provisions commenced on assent
Registration, compliance declaration and related Parts commenced

direction_rationale: New registration requirements for designers and engineers on apartment projects add a licensing barrier and compliance costs, likely reducing the number of firms able to supply this work.

industries.name: Engineering Design and Engineering Consulting Services

comparison: Other states without engineer registration (SA, WA, TAS, NT until later); Victoria phased in 2021-23; QLD long-standing RPEQ
confounders: Residential Apartment Buildings (Compliance and Enforcement Powers) Act 2020

assessment.summary: Requires designers, builders and engineers on apartment projects to register and to declare that designs and work comply. It aims to cut building defects; the productivity cost is the paperwork and the narrower pool of practitioners who may do the work.

marks.reason: Adds registration, design compliance declarations and documentation for every class 2 (apartment) project.
Only registered practitioners may design or certify apartment work, narrowing who can supply it.

assessment.confidence_note: Benefits from fewer defects, which may lower costs later, are not weighed here.
